newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 20.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 20.

text.p: These were the headlines on Estonian Kuku radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- United States President Clinton arrived in Helsinki on Air Force One.
- Parliament completed the first reading of a bill for establishing an independent auditor to audit the state audit office.
- Tallinn city government will announce tomorrow the exact plan for the sale of the city's water and sewage utility.
